description: Validator/Bughunter/Fixer finding with semantic scheduling effect (D76 §5.3 and D74 §11.2).
title: Finding
x-admits: For each material issue, record one effect: forward-blocking, closure-blocking-forward-safe, or advisory. Tie the finding to exact criteria or forward edges and evidence. Do not use severity alone to decide scheduling, do not hide a mandatory blocker as advisory, and do not report a source repair requirement without the evidence that makes it mandatory.
